title: Had there been flowerbeds
html_source:
Stephen (probably unknowingly) practices one of Loyola’s Jesuit spiritual exercises, ‘the composition of place’, visualizing scenes in as much detail as possible.

See, for example, The Spiritual Exercises of St. Ignatious of Loyola.
